name: 035.4 fixture
_comment: A whole sheet as data -- text AND chrome -- shaped exactly like the bundled `theme` example's file.
Everything here is a JSON value the sheet already understands (a colour array, a 9-slice's four insets,
a pad in pixels); the only two things it cannot hold are handles, a font's `face` and an image path.
The suite asserts the geometry these numbers predict, so the file is what drives the window's size.
The last rule is a TREE key, and it is here because a file can carry one: it names one window rather
than a kind of surface, and widget:style() reads back what it resolved to.
